description: Documented Painter Python API symbols (approved source A-PYDOC: every Python object of the Painter 12.1.0 python-doc inventory, plus the enum members and constructor parameters recorded in tools/parity/recorder/documented_symbols.json), each with its status per operation context and its documentation anchor as evidence. Input of generate_capabilities.py; see tools/capabilities/README.md.

Release gap (decision 204): the PNG export of a BaseColor, Specular or Emissive stored as L8 is refused with NotYetSupported before any map file is written under OCIO, and in any file other than the RGB file whose R, G and B (or the L file whose L) read those letters of the one L8 channel. In those files Painter writes the sRGB encode of the linear value in R, B and L and its linear write in G (Dota 2's empty L8 Specular, float32(10/255), is (14330, 2570, 14330) at PNG 16), byte-identical to tier0/semantics/export-l8-material and export-template-base-dota-2 at PNG 8 and 16 (r1 and r2); other channel mappings and OCIO are not recorded. Its OpenEXR export holds the linear value and is exact.

entries.notes: Painter also replaces a mesh map's resource. The facade rebinds, in the same transaction as the layer stacks, every mesh map bound to the named resource, matched by its given name and content: a mesh map bound to another name of the same bytes keeps its binding, and replacing a resource by itself returns [] and changes nothing (p22b-mesh-map-alias-update and phase1-mesh-map-update, both recordings; decision 336).
